content.title: Iowa State Wrestling Results From Day One Of NCAA Wrestling Championships - FloWrestling
content.text: The opening day of action at the 2026 NCAA D1 Wrestling Championships had ended. As all is calm in Cleveland, OH for now, the Iowa State Cyclones are hoping to carry the momentum of mostly positive day in to the second day of action. More Information On FloWrestling And The FloSports AppSee 2026 College Wrestling Rankings By FloWrestlingFloWrestling's 2026 NCAA Wrestling Championships Watch PartyFloWrestling Radio Live At The NCAA ChampionshipsAs the dust settled on Mar. 19, the Cyclones find themselves in sixth in the team standings. In the middle of the pack also lies teams like Ohio State and fellow Big 12 rival Arizona State. With a full day of wrestling under their belts, Iowa State managed to walk away with 21.5 points after a gruesome day on the mats. Here is a look at how the Cyclones handled business on the opening day. Iowa State Wrestling Round of 16 Results On Mar. 19125lbs: No.13 Stevo Poulin is defeated by No. 4 Sheldon Seymour, 5-4 in Dec. 141lbs: No.4 Anthony Echemendia picks up the Cyclones first win of the day. Enchmendia defeats no. 13 Wyatt Henson, 14-4 in a MD.149lbs: No.16 Jacob Frost drops the match to No. 1 Shayne Van Ness in a Fall in 2:23. 165lbs: No.15 Connor Euton drops the match to No. 2 Joey Blaze in MD, 10-1.174lbs: No. 11 MJ Gaitan upsets No. 6 Matty Singleton in a Dec, 6-3. 197lbs: No. 2 Rocky Elam suffers a major defeat against No. 15 Remy Cotton. Elam falls in MD fashion, 12-4.285lbs: No. 1 Yonnger Bastida demolishes No. 16 Jimmy Mullen by a major TF, 20-4.
